# It's Lit Neon

> Premium custom neon wall clocks — personalized with your name, logo, photo, business, team, garage, or bar. Hand-built one at a time by Light Me Up Productions.

It's Lit Neon (itslitneon.com) sells two products: a Regular Neon Clock ($99) with a pre-designed face and a Custom Neon Clock ($125) personalized for the buyer. Every clock has a chrome border, quartz movement, and a glowing neon ring in the buyer's chosen color. Orders are taken through a guided design form and built to order. Contact: support@itslitneon.com.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, hero showcase, recent builds, and ordering options.
- [Custom Stable Order](/custom-order): Simple manual order flow for the horse racing community — no checkout, no charge until artwork is approved. Customer submits name, contact, shipping address, stable name, and logo; Joe reviews, sends a proof, then sends an invoice for payment.
- [Shop](/shop): Design a custom or regular neon clock — upload artwork, pick colors and neon glow, see a live preview, and check out.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of custom neon clocks built for businesses, garages, bars, and gifts.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): The 4-step design and build process from idea to delivery.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers about turnaround, artwork requirements, neon colors, shipping (U.S. starts at $30; multiple clocks combined; international/Canadian quoted separately), and ordering.
- [Contact](/contact): Text, call, or email Joe to start a custom neon clock order.
